# opnsense_plugin (Resource)

Installs and removes an OPNsense firmware plugin package. Package operations are asynchronous and Terraform waits for their inventory state to converge.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firmware plugin package to install.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Plugin package name.
- `repository` (String) Repository that provides the plugin.
- `version` (String) Installed plugin version.
